title: Get a licence for an advertising sign in a public place
what: Get the council's licence before putting an advertising sign or bill on a road, footpath, council property or other public place.

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. Amended later (Gazette No. 32, 18 Feb 2005, Gazette No. 25, 18 Feb 2014); the amendments were not read.

assessment.summary: Advertising signs in public places need the council's licence.
